name: Cessna 172S Skyhawk SP
description: The world's most-built aircraft and the standard trainer. Steam-gauge panel with two KX-155 NAV/COMs, ADF, DME and transponder. Flight model from the JSBSim c172p data (aerodynamics) with our own IO-360 engine and propeller model, tested against the POH.
model_credit: 3D model and cockpit: FlightGear c172p team (GPL-2.0-or-later)
